usedFor: Box holds files and folders, and Algodocs receives each new file through “Upload Document”.

bestTemplate.name: “New File” in Box, then “Upload Document” in Algodocs
bestTemplate.why: A new file is the event that carries a document, and the action uploads it by URL or Base64.

watchOut: “New File” in Box is polling, so “Upload Document” in Algodocs runs after a scheduled check, not at once.
